Triage + release board (objectui seat PM — this repo's board producer): `pm:queue` + `target:v17`, class ④ — the scaffolded app renders ObjectUI components with none of the library's styling (the missing `@import "@object-ui/components/style.css"` is measured load-bearing by #3884's matrix), and the CLI's own output contradicts what quick-start teaches. Same board rationale as #3892.

**ACCEPT** — closed by PR #4067 together with #4061 (sweep pair). The generated `src/index.css` now imports `@object-ui/components/style.css` (the measured load-bearing sheet), gated by a rule — every declared `@object-ui/*` dependency that publishes a `./style.css` export must be imported, and only those — so the fields phantom (#4059) is structurally excluded. The `@tailwindcss/postcss` vs `@tailwindcss/vite` docs divergence is flagged in the PR body for the maintainer, unchanged. Full review record on #4061.
